result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. I changed one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (around line 10021). It uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` clause as the sales-rep list. The docstring now says so too. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`RegionManagerTest` passes offline (`mvn -q -o test -Dtest=RegionManagerTest`, no output on success). I did not add a test that checks the new order against your T-1 to T-5 example, and I did not commit.
